formation.title: The Birth of the Baltic Nation
formation.text:
The scattered Baltic tribes (Curonians, Samogitians, Semigallians, Latgalians, Old Prussians) have at last been united under a single banner. For centuries, these peoples have shared a language, a faith in the sacred groves, and a stubborn refusal to bow before foreign invaders. The Northern Crusaders broke themselves against our forest fortresses; the Amber Road carried our wealth to the courts of Europe. Now the question is: what kind of nation shall we become?

The sacred groves of Romuva still burn with the eternal flame, calling us to preserve our ancient ways and defend our forest homeland. But the amber-rich coast beckons too, promising wealth and influence for those bold enough to take to the sea.

This choice unlocks a destiny path in the Traditions tab.

options.text: Guard the sacred groves and the old ways

modifiers.name: Guardians of the Sacred Groves
modifiers.text: The Baltic peoples draw strength from their ancient forests and sacred groves. No crusader army has conquered what the trees protect.

options.text: Claim dominion over the Amber Coast

modifiers.name: Lords of the Amber Coast
modifiers.text: The Curonians were once called the Baltic Vikings for their mastery of the sea. Now a united Baltic people turns that seafaring heritage into a commercial empire.

advances.name: Romuva Worship
advances.text: The sacred groves of the Baltic peoples, where the eternal flame burns and the Kriwe-Kriwajto communes with the spirits of the dead.

advances.name: Curonian Warriors
advances.text: The Curonians, feared as the Baltic Vikings, bring their fierce warrior tradition to the unified Baltic army.

event.title: The Battle of Saule
event.text: In 1236, at the marshy crossing near Saule, the Samogitians and their Curonian allies met the Livonian Brothers of the Sword in battle. The crusaders, weighed down by heavy armor in the boggy terrain, were destroyed almost to a man. Their Grand Master Volkwin fell alongside fifty knights: the worst defeat the Baltic crusading orders ever suffered. The remnants of the Sword Brothers were absorbed into the Teutonic Order, but the lesson endured: the Baltic peoples would not submit easily. Our warriors carry the memory of Saule in their blood.

modifiers.name: Victory at Saule
modifiers.text: The crushing defeat of the Livonian Brothers of the Sword at Saule in 1236 echoes through Baltic martial tradition.

advances.name: Amber Crafting
advances.text: Baltic artisans transform raw amber into jewelry, amulets, and decorative objects prized across Europe.

advances.name: Forest Warfare
advances.text: The dense forests of the Baltic lands are both home and fortress to their peoples, who know every path and clearing.

advances.name: Hill Fort Tradition
advances.text: The pilskalns, Baltic hilltop fortifications of earthworks and timber, have defended these lands for centuries.

advances.name: Honey and Wax Economy
advances.text:
The vast bee forests of the Baltic region produce honey and beeswax in quantities that supply churches across Western Europe.

Available in: Amber Workshop

advances.name: Tribal Assembly
advances.text: The gathering of Baltic chieftains to settle disputes, allocate resources, and coordinate defense against common enemies.

advances.name: The Amber Road
advances.text: The ancient trade route carrying Baltic amber south to the Mediterranean and east to Byzantium reaches new heights of prosperity.

event.title: The Amber Road Ascendancy
event.text: Baltic amber (the golden tears of the sun, as the ancients called it) has been traded since the Bronze Age. From the shores of Curonia and Sambia, amber traveled south along river routes to the Mediterranean, east to the courts of Byzantium, and west to the workshops of Bruges. Now, with the Baltic tribes united, we control the source of this precious commodity entirely. We can dictate terms to every merchant who seeks our amber, but do we tighten our grip on the trade itself, or use our position to draw merchants to our shores and profit from the flow?

modifiers.name: Amber Road Dominance
modifiers.text: By controlling the amber trade routes, we dictate the flow of northern gold across Europe.

options.text: Make our ports the amber gateway

modifiers.name: Amber Gateway
modifiers.text: Our ports have become the premier destination for merchants seeking Baltic amber, drawing wealth and commerce to our shores.

advances.name: Curonian Seafaring
advances.text: The Curonians mastered shipbuilding and navigation in the Viking tradition, raiding as far as Denmark and Sweden.

advances.name: The Sacred Fire
advances.text: The last pagan tradition in Europe endures in the Baltic lands, where the sacred flame of Romuva still burns.

event.title: The Sacred Flame of Romuva
event.text: In the heart of the Baltic lands, deep within a sacred oak grove, burns a fire that has never been extinguished. The Kriwe-Kriwajto, highest priest of all the Baltic peoples, tends this flame as a bridge between the living and the dead. While every other pagan tradition in Europe has fallen to the Cross, the Romuva faith endures. Our people still leave offerings at the sacred stones, still whisper to the spirits of the forest, still mark the turning of seasons with ancient rites that predate Christianity by millennia. This is not mere superstition: it is the spiritual core of Baltic identity.

modifiers.name: The Sacred Flame of Romuva
modifiers.text: The eternal flame in the sacred grove of Romuva binds the Baltic peoples to their ancestors and their ancient faith.

advances.name: Crusader Resistance
advances.text: Decades of warfare against the Teutonic and Livonian Orders have forged the Baltic peoples into hardened defenders.

advances.name: Forest Products Trade
advances.text: Baltic furs, honey, wax, tar, and timber flow westward along established trade networks to Hanseatic markets.

advances.name: Samogitian Cavalry
advances.text: The horsemen of Samogitia, masters of guerrilla warfare in forested terrain, form the mobile striking force of the Baltic army.

advances.name: Baltic Confederation
advances.text: The political unification of the diverse Baltic tribes into a single governing structure.

event.title: The Baltic Confederation
event.text: The unification of the Baltic peoples was forged in the crucible of shared struggle against the crusading orders. But now that the external threat has receded, the question of governance grows urgent. The Samogitians, Curonians, Latgalians, and Prussians each have their own traditions, their own chieftains, their own sense of identity. Should we forge a strong central authority that can direct the resources of all Baltic lands toward common purpose? Or should we honor the autonomy of each tribe, creating a confederation where local customs and freedoms are preserved?

options.text: One ruler for all the Baltic peoples

modifiers.name: Centralized Baltic Authority
modifiers.text: A strong central government directs the resources of all Baltic lands toward a common purpose.

modifiers.name: Baltic Tribal Federation
modifiers.text: The confederation preserves the autonomy and customs of each Baltic tribe while binding them together against external threats.

advances.name: Coastal Vigilance
advances.text:
Baltic tar distilleries support coastal defense, producing vital stores for shipbuilding and fortification while watchtowers guard the shoreline.

Available in: Amber Workshop

advances.name: Pagan Resurgence
advances.text: A revival of traditional Baltic religious practices reasserts the cultural identity of the Baltic peoples.

advances.name: Baltic Trade Network
advances.text: Fortified trading posts along the Baltic coast create a unified commercial network rivaling the Hansa.

advances.name: Amber Monopoly
advances.text: Complete control over the world's primary amber deposits gives the Baltic nation enormous economic leverage.

advances.name: Forest Military Doctrine
advances.text:
Centuries of forest warfare are codified into formal military doctrine, with specialized garrisons in the hill forts.

Available in: Pilskalns

advances.name: Cultural Preservation
advances.text: Deliberate efforts to protect Baltic languages, traditions, and customs from assimilation by neighboring powers.

advances.name: Modern Baltic Army
advances.text: A professional army combining modern tactics with the Baltic tradition of forest warfare.

advances.name: National Awakening
advances.text: The emergence of Baltic national consciousness, inspired by Enlightenment ideals and the rediscovery of ancient heritage.

advances.name: Industrial Forestry
advances.text:
Modernized methods of timber harvesting and naval stores production supply the Baltic trading posts.

Available in: Amber Workshop

advances.name: Modern Baltic Commerce
advances.text: Integration of Baltic ports into modern European trade networks transforms the coastal economy.

destiny.name: Destiny of the Baltic Nation
destiny.text: The Baltic peoples have united. Now begins the true test: will this nation endure and grow, or crumble under the weight of its neighbors' ambitions?

conditions.text: Stability at least 25

event.title: Destiny of the Baltic Nation
event.text: The Baltic nation stands at the threshold of greatness. We have united the Curonians, Samogitians, Prussians, and Latgalians under a single banner, a feat that seemed impossible when the crusading orders first marched into our forests. But unification was only the beginning. The great powers of Europe still look upon us as a barbarian curiosity, a pagan anachronism that will soon fall to the march of civilization. We shall prove them wrong.

options.text: Our destiny is our own to forge

destiny.name: The Sacred Frontier
destiny.text: The lands east of our homeland are contested ground between Romuva and Christendom. Secure Polotsk and Vitebsk to anchor the sacred frontier.

conditions.text: We have chosen to guard the sacred groves.
Stability at least 25
Gold at least 1000
Own Polotsk, or a subject owns it
Own Vitebsk, or a subject owns it

event.title: The Sacred Frontier
event.text: Our warriors have pushed eastward into the Ruthenian borderlands, planting the sacred oak where once only the cross stood. Polotsk and Vitebsk, ancient cities of the Dvina trade route, now answer to Baltic authority. The priests of Romuva follow our soldiers, rekindling the old ways in lands that had forgotten them. The frontier between the pagan Baltic world and Orthodox Christendom has shifted decisively in our favor.

options.text: The sacred oaks grow where the cross once stood

destiny.name: The Pagan Kingdom
destiny.text: Bring the great city of Kyiv under Baltic rule and build it up. Let the Orthodox see what pagan wisdom can build.

conditions.text: Prestige at least 50
We own Kyiv and its development is at least 36

event.title: The Pagan Kingdom
event.text: The capture of Kyiv sends shockwaves through Christendom. The mother of all Rus' cities, the cradle of Orthodox civilization in the east, now flies the banner of a pagan king. Chroniclers across Europe write of this event with horror and fascination in equal measure. For the Baltic peoples, it is vindication: proof that the old gods have not abandoned those who kept faith. But how shall we govern this vast realm? With the iron hand of a conqueror, or with the wisdom of a people who have survived by adaptation?

options.text: Let the old gods march eastward

modifiers.name: Romuva Ascendant
modifiers.text: The old faith advances where the cross retreats. Our siege engineers batter down the walls of Christian strongholds with righteous fury.

options.text: We endure by bending without breaking

modifiers.name: Pagan Resilience
modifiers.text: The Baltic peoples have survived crusades, famines, and plagues. This resilience now sustains our growing realm.

destiny.name: The Eternal Flame
destiny.text: The last pagan kingdom in Europe must become its mightiest. Vilnius, where the eternal fire burns, is to be built up into a great capital, and Moscow and Smolensk conquered to break Christian hegemony once and for all.

conditions.text: Prestige at least 75
We own Vilnius and its development is at least 45
Own Moscow, or a subject owns it
Own Smolensk, or a subject owns it

event.title: The Eternal Flame
event.text: Moscow has fallen. Smolensk has fallen. The two pillars of Orthodox military power in the north have been brought under the rule of the last pagan kingdom in Europe. The eternal flame of Romuva, which the crusaders swore they would extinguish, now burns brighter than ever, its light visible, metaphorically, from the walls of every Christian capital. This is the apex of Baltic power, the moment when the impossible became real. The question now is what kind of empire this shall be: one of unconquered warriors, or one of enlightened wisdom?

options.text: We are the flame that never dies

modifiers.name: The Flame Unconquered
modifiers.text: No army has extinguished the sacred flame. Our warriors carry its spirit into battle: swift, relentless, and unconquerable.

options.text: Wisdom burns brighter than any sword

modifiers.name: The Flame Enlightened
modifiers.text: The wisdom of the sacred flame illuminates all peoples under our rule. Integration and learning flourish in the pagan kingdom.

destiny.name: The Amber Coast
destiny.text: The Hanseatic League has grown fat on Baltic trade. Seize Lubeck, the heart of their network, and redirect that wealth to our coast.

conditions.text: We have chosen to claim the Amber Coast.
Stability at least 25
Gold at least 1000
Own Lübeck, or a subject owns it

event.title: The Amber Coast
event.text: Lubeck, the Queen of the Hanse, has been humbled. For centuries, German merchants grew wealthy by controlling the flow of Baltic goods (our amber, our furs, our beeswax) to Western markets, paying a fraction of their true value. No longer. With Lubeck under our control, the entire Hanseatic trading network must reckon with Baltic power. The amber that washes up on our shores will enrich our treasuries, not those of foreign merchants.

options.text: The amber trade belongs to the Baltic

destiny.name: Command the Baltic
destiny.text: Control the crossroads of Baltic Sea trade by taking Visby on Gotland and the Swedish capital at Stockholm.

conditions.text: Army size at least 50
Own Visby, or a subject owns it
Own Stockholm, or a subject owns it

event.title: Command the Baltic
event.text: Gotland and Stockholm are ours. The island of Gotland, the ancient crossroads of Baltic commerce where Viking traders once gathered, now serves as a Baltic naval base commanding the sea lanes. Stockholm, the key to Scandinavian waters, opens the northern routes to our merchants. The Curonian seafaring tradition, once dismissed as mere piracy, has evolved into the foundation of a maritime empire. The Baltic Sea is becoming our sea.

options.text: Rule the waves with iron and oak

modifiers.name: Sea Dominion
modifiers.text: Our warships command the Baltic waves. The cost of maintaining both army and fleet strains the treasury, but the sea is ours.

options.text: Build a league of amber and silver

modifiers.name: Baltic Trade League
modifiers.text: A network of Baltic trading posts replaces the Hanseatic system, channeling commerce through our ports and warehouses.

destiny.name: Mare Balticum
destiny.text: Make the Baltic Sea a Baltic lake. Take Copenhagen to control the Sound, build up Konigsberg on the Sambian amber shore, and ensure amber flows through our markets to all of Europe.

event.title: Mare Balticum
event.text: Copenhagen has fallen, and with it, control of the Danish Sound, the narrow passage between the Baltic and the North Sea. Every ship that passes through these straits now sails under our sufferance. From Lubeck to Stockholm, from Gotland to Copenhagen, the Baltic Sea is a Baltic lake. The amber trade, once a modest stream of golden tears carried south by patient merchants, has become a torrent of wealth flowing through our kontors. The descendants of the Curonian Vikings have built an empire not of conquest alone, but of commerce, seamanship, and the golden bounty of the sea.

options.text: The Baltic Sea is our empire

modifiers.name: Amber Empire
modifiers.text: From Lubeck to Copenhagen, the amber trade flows through a Baltic maritime empire of unrivaled naval power.

options.text: Amber kings need no crown but commerce

modifiers.name: Merchant Princes of the Baltic
modifiers.text: The merchant elite of the Baltic coast have become princes in all but name, their amber wealth buying peace and influence across Europe.

units.name: Curonian Raiders
units.text: Fierce foot warriors from the Curonian coast, feared throughout the Baltic as the Baltic Vikings for their raiding prowess.

units.name: Curonian Longship
units.text: A fast, shallow-draft vessel built in the Viking tradition by Curonian shipwrights. Excellent for coastal raiding and blockade.

units.name: Samogitian Light Horse
units.text: Swift cavalry from the forested highlands of Samogitia, masters of hit-and-run tactics against armored knights.

units.name: Baltic Riflemen
units.text: Professional infantry combining modern musketry with centuries of expertise in forest combat.

buildings.name: Sacred Grove
buildings.text: A consecrated grove of ancient oaks where the eternal flame of Romuva burns and the Kriwe-Kriwajto performs ancestral rites.

buildings.name: Amber Workshop
buildings.text: A workshop where Baltic artisans process raw amber into jewelry, religious objects, and decorative pieces for export.

buildings.name: Pilskalns
buildings.text: A Baltic hilltop fortification of earthworks and timber palisades, designed to exploit the natural terrain against invaders.

buildings.name: Baltic Trading Post
buildings.text: A fortified coastal trading station where amber, furs, honey, and wax are exchanged with foreign merchants.

buildings.name: Romuva Temple
buildings.text: A grand stone temple complex housing the eternal flame of Romuva, where the Kriwe-Kriwajto presides as the supreme spiritual authority of all Baltic peoples.

buildings.name: Amber Kontor
buildings.text: A grand Baltic trading house controlling the amber trade, modeled on the Hanseatic kontors but serving Baltic rather than German interests.

list.name: Ponų Taryba
list.text: The Council of Lords (Ponų Taryba, Rada Litewska in the Polish chancery) crystallised in the 1430s from the Grand Duke's informal council and was legalised by Alexander Jagiellon's privilege of 1492. From that point the Grand Duke could not conduct foreign policy, appoint a voivode, or remove a high official without the Council's consent. Lower posts had to be filled in the presence of the voivodes of Vilnius and Trakai. The benches were filled by the great Catholic magnate houses (Radvilos, Goštautai, Kęsgailos, Olelkovičiai), making the Council the institutional voice of the Lithuanian senatorial class.

list.name: Lietuvos Statutai
list.text: The three Lithuanian Statutes (1529, 1566, 1588) codified the law of the Grand Duchy half a century before Poland obtained any equivalent. Drafted in the chancery Ruthenian of Vilnius, the First Statute was sealed under Sigismund I at the initiative of the Council of Lords; the Second, vastly enlarged, came into force under Sigismund Augustus; the Third was confirmed by Sigismund III Vasa on 28 January 1588 and remained in force in the Lithuanian provinces until the nineteenth century. The Statutes bound boyar privilege to royal procedure and gave the chancery's jurists a working profession.

list.name: Vaivadijos ir Pavietai
list.text: After the Union of Horodlo in 1413, the Grand Duchy adopted the Polish administrative model of voivode and castellan, which Sigismund Augustus's reforms of 1565-66 matured into thirteen palatinates and their constituent powiats. Each was led by a voivode who summoned the regional levy and presided over its sejmik, with a starosta administering crown estates and dispensing high justice. The Castle Court (Pilies Teismas) of Vilnius and the corresponding courts in the chief towns drew the Duchy's nobility into a Polish-style procedural system while keeping the Lithuanian land-administration intact.

list.name: Lietuvos Metrika
list.text: The Lithuanian Metrica was the chancellery's continuous register of every privilege, judgment, treaty, and land grant of the Grand Duchy, kept from the late fourteenth century in the chancery Ruthenian of Vilnius. More than 600 books survive from before 1697, the year Polish and Latin finally supplanted Ruthenian as the working language of the Commonwealth's chancellery. The literate scribes who maintained the Metrica were drawn from the Orthodox Ruthenian nobility, the Catholic burgher class, and the cathedral clergy of Vilnius: the Duchy's institutional memory.

list.name: Didysis Etmonas
list.text: The office of Grand Hetman of Lithuania (didysis etmonas, hetman wielki litewski) was instituted on 11 September 1497 with the appointment of Prince Konstanty Ostrogski, victor over the Tatars at Ochakiv. The Grand Hetman commanded the Duchy's field armies in war, supervised border fortifications and garrisons in peace, and issued binding military ordinances; a Field Hetman (lauko etmonas) deputised in the field. The post was held for life and almost always from the great magnate houses (Ostrogski, Radvila, Sapieha, Chodkiewicz), fusing the Duchy's military command with its senatorial elite.

conditions.text: Any of

list.name: Vilniaus Akademija
list.text: On 1 April 1579 King Stephen Báthory granted a letter of privilege raising the Jesuit College of Vilnius (founded in 1570 at the invitation of Bishop Valerijonas Protasevičius) to the rank of full studium generale; Pope Gregory XIII confirmed the foundation that October. It was the third university of the Polish-Lithuanian realm after the Cracow Academy and the Albertina, and the only one in the Grand Duchy. Vilnius's Jesuit masters trained the chancery's jurists, the cathedral clergy, and the next generation of magnate sons in Latin learning and Counter-Reformation theology.
